steps.path: Open a past conversation → the search box and the row of chips under it
steps.headline: This is what done means for the Projects, Tags and Most recent chips and their menus.

rows.statement: The three chips match the app's other filter chips in size and shape, with a chevron that points up while a menu is open.
The Projects menu shows square check boxes, a count on each row, and a Clear button pinned at the bottom.
The Tags menu opens straight onto your tags, each with its count, and Clear sits at the bottom.
A chip names the one tag or project you picked; two or more show as a count, like Tags 2.
On a wide window the three chips stay as a full row; only a phone-width window folds them into the filter button.
rows.note: could we collapse into the expandable filter menu button thing used in the project view and session file view things? only on mobile/narrow, leave as full chips on desktop/wide

rows.statement: The sort chip flips the order with one tap; it does not open a menu.
This screen keeps saying sessions: Resume Session, Search sessions, No matching sessions, and the reopen button stays Resume Session.
The dialog keeps shrinking to fit a short list when you filter; it is not held at one fixed height.
The sort chip carries the sort bars, three bars with a down arrow, and lights up while the order is oldest first.
Below 640 px the chips row is gone; the search pill holds the filter button, with a count badge when a filter is on.
Manage tags… is gone from the Tags menu; Clear stands alone in its footer, like the Projects menu.
The phone filter panel holds the desktop chips: Projects and Tags dropdowns and the Most recent sort chip, with Clear at the top.
A dropdown opened inside the phone panel is the desktop menu; picking rows keeps both open, and a tap outside closes them together.
After one tap the sort bars turn narrow-to-wide for oldest first, and nothing else on the row changes.
